text:
Mara: Quick thread — benchmark visuals + webinar hook. Thinking of shifting the main narrative from "avg latency vs $" to a reliability-first framing: show how different serving configs meet 99th‑percentile SLAs at different unit costs.

Devin: Yes — mean latency hides tail behavior. Customers ask "will my app stay snappy under peak load?" not "what's the mean".

Sam: Design requests (3 tiles):
- Tile A: SLA compliance curve — probability of meeting 99th <= X ms vs cost per 1M tokens (lines for configs)
- Tile B: Cost waterfall per 100k requests (batching, cache, compute slices)
- Tile C: Persona vignette (chat vs search vs embeddings) with annotated tradeoffs

Leah: For Tile A can you drop a tiny CSV so design can mock quickly?

Mara: Quick mock numbers (rows: latency_threshold_ms, small-batch, medium-batch, prefix-cache):
```
latency_ms,small_batch,medium_batch,prefix_cache
150,0.62,0.75,0.93
200,0.78,0.89,0.98
250,0.90,0.95,0.995
300,0.95,0.985,0.999
```
Costs (USD per 1M tokens): small_batch=1200, medium_batch=850, prefix_cache=420
```
config,cost_per_1M
small_batch,1200
medium_batch,850
prefix_cache,420
```

Tom: Good — design can plot probabilistic curves and put cost ticks on the cost axis. Add explicit SLA language: "99th under X ms" + "$ per 1M tokens" labels.

Mara: Proposed hero copy options — choose one: 
1) "Keep app snappy: 99th percentile latency under 250ms at predictable unit cost"
2) "Reduce per-query spend 2–3x while preserving tail latency"
3) "Guaranteed SLA-ready inference for chat, search, and embeddings"

Sam: I like #2 for demand gen (savings sells). #1 is good for enterprise docs.

Leah: Webinar hook idea: short live demo showing (a) an app under synthetic load, (b) flip routing to a cheaper model variant + enable prefix cache, (c) tail stays within SLA and cost drops. Leave 10 minutes for live Q&A.

Mara: Ops asks: can eng provide a reproducible traffic script and a small dashboard that reports 99th over a 1M token run? We want both a live demo and a 5-minute pre-recorded clip.

Devin: Eng can do a canary run and add tracing spans that export 99th. Will annotate the moment we flip routing. ETA: 3 days for a clean recording.

Tom: Inbound routing / lead tags for follow-up: tag leads who engage with benchmark content with ["lead:tail-sla", "lead:unit-econ", "lead:embeddings-efficiency"]. Nurture path: benchmark whitepaper -> 5-min demo -> sales playbook w/ config templates.

Mara: Action items — design + content + growth- Design: produce the 3 visuals from the CSV mock by EOD Thursday- Content: one-pager (hero claim + 3 bullets + CTA) and webinar script draft- Growth: wire lead tags and basic funnel in HubSpot/GA

Sam: I'll draft the one-pager. Rough CTA: "See how we keep your SLA — and cut spend — in one click."

Leah: Webinar length: 30 minutes (20 demo, 10 Q&A). Target date: 2 weeks out. I'll start the signup page and slide template.

Mara: Thanks — please drop early PNGs and trace logs here when ready and I9ll lock the hero claim by Friday.

marketing-bot: Reminder: sprint milestone created — "benchmark-sla-visuals" due in 10 days. :rocket:
